title: an allocation failure states the bytes required, the bytes available and the largest consumers
note: CMP-043: the memory of a program is limited by the target profile (8192 bytes of WORK on posix, one of them the initialization flag); the failure names what the program needs, what the target has, and which variables take the most
messageIncludes: Largest consumers: Overflow.Table (9000 bytes), Overflow.Gain (4 bytes)
